sections.title: Hotfix Gameplay Update
sections.description: This is a hotfix containing gameplay updates. Replay codes from the June 16 patch are still available.

sections.title: Anima Strike Event
sections.description:
- Daily quest requirements for games played lowered from 3/7/12 to 3/6/10.
- Weekly quest requirements for games played lowered from 25/30/50 to 20/30/45.
